speaker: Head Coach
quote_text:
Let’s start this press conference with Luis  Enrique. Hi coach, congratulations for this  
new piece of silverware. With this title,  you become the most decorated coach in Paris  
Saint-Germain’s history. What does this mean for  you? How are you feeling after this game? It can  
only be positive. It’s a dream that’s come true.  I’m just so happy. I’m so happy. But first of all,  
I just want to underline one thing. Today I think  that we came up against a coach who should have  
been able to play this final with Warren. It  was very unfair, but for the minutes that he  
was able to play, he showed just how special he  was. I would like to underline that. It was very  
unfair for Warren. I think it was a high-level  final against one of the most difficult opponents,  
especially when they hit the net within the first  10 minutes. Their plan was perfectly executed and  
for us it put us into hot water, especially during  the first half. We weren’t finding spaces. It was  
very difficult. I think we got better and  were able to get better in the second half.  
But when you come up against a team like Arsenal,  they have got a low block, they are perfectly  
defending, physically attacking. It is no mean  feat. It is hard to break through. We have had  
lots of draws and I think there were probably  times that we could have won the game. But this  
back to back has been incredible. So complicated,  so difficult. But we are happy and proud of our  
supporters, of everyone who supports our team,  who has got behind the team. We are so happy. And  
now let’s party. Last year, from August, you  announced that you wanted that back to back,  
you wanted that second star and you have pulled it  off this evening. Are you already thinking about  
the third one? Obviously we all have objectives  and when autumn comes round then we will think  
about our objectives. But right now it is the  summer. We have written history. We are going down  
in history. We played the Club World Cup last year  after the Champions League and it was really hard  
for us. The majority of players now are actually  going off with their national squads to the World  
Cup, another high-level competition. But for us  as staff, excuse me, we are just going to let our  
hair down a little bit this summer. We can talk  about the back to back to back. We are happy to  
have these types of objectives here because our  club is worthy of this. Our supporter is worthy  
of this. Could you maybe talk me through how the  penalty shootout session went for you? Especially,  
how did you choose who was going to be taking the  penalties? It was business as usual. I had six on  
the list. They decided amongst themselves who  wanted to go and in which order. Ocho is a real  
specialist. We knew just how skilful he is to put  the opponent in a sticky situation for the penalty  
shootout. I wanted everyone to go into it with  a clear head, just to get it over with. It was a  
game that was very tight. It was very hard. Every  single time there was a set piece, we were against  
the strongest team for set pieces in the whole of  Europe. But I think that we were able to carry the  
game. I think we were able to dominate. And I’m so  happy. I believe that we deserve the trophy. If I  
were to analyse everything, all of the season and  all of the difficulties that we have had in the  
Champions League with the scheduling, I think that  we clearly deserve the win. Our second Champions  
League win. We all know that you are extremely  attentive to details and you are a master of  
that. We saw it in last year’s final with the  kick-off. We saw it against Bayern Munich with  
the goal kicks. This final is played at 6pm local  time instead of 9pm. I would like to know if it  
changed your game preparation a little bit, or  if it was not an influential element for you. No,  
we try to adapt all the time to the different  circumstances that are in football. You have to  
be ready. And I think one of the best things  that we have as a team is our resilience.  
We are able to play where we need to play.  We are able to overcome all the problems. And  
today we showed everybody that even if Arsenal are  destructive when they have a one-goal advantage,  
we overcame that. We played until the last  minute of extra time at the same intensity.  
I think we showed again the level of the team,  individually and collectively. Last question.  
Congratulations. You and your team won everything  twice, including the Champions League final. I  
would like to ask you, are you going to keep the  core of the team for next season? Will we see  
Vitinha with you and other stars? Well, that  is another chapter. But we are going to follow  
the same line. We do not need a lot of players  because it is very difficult to find the right  
players to play in our team. We feel clearly the  way and the path that we want to follow. And we  
are going to analyse. We are working, especially  after that match. We are working in the future,  
but we are not in a hurry. We already  have a great squad and we need, of course,  
some players to change some different positions.  But we are the champions of Europe the last two  
years. Piano, piano. Thank you. Congratulations  one more time and thank you for your questions.
title: ENRIQUE: “WE DESERVE THE TROPHY!  PSG 1-1 Arsenal (Pens 4-3)  Champions League Final
